note: Re-judged 2026-10-14 (independent reader, after 8c1c4013f2 and 7d37dcd562). RFC 9252 Section 7: 'The path having any such Prefix-SID attribute without any valid SRv6 SID information MUST be considered ineligible during the selection of the best path for the corresponding prefix.' The earlier findings are answered: isSRv6Ineligible now calls ExtractSRv6SIDFull and srv6SIDValidForFamily, so an invalid SID Structure or a transposition wider than the label field excludes the path. Negatives: TestIsSRv6Ineligible_InvalidSIDStructure (sum 200) and TestSRv6TranspositionWiderThanLabelFieldIsIneligible (24 bits into 20) feed a received VPNv4 UPDATE and assert candidateAdmitted, the gate checkRouteBestChange applies, refuses the stored path; srv6-invalid-sid-ineligible.ci asserts through the daemon that only the valid path of three has a best path. Positives: TestSRv6TranspositionAtLabelWidthIsEligible (exactly 20 bits) is admitted with its SID reconstructed, and TestIsSRv6Ineligible_ValidSID. TestIsSRv6Ineligible_InvalidSID is a structurally malformed Sub-TLV (treat-as-withdraw upstream) and is supplementary.
